notes: FRED-MD adjusted series for manufacturers' new orders of durable goods. McCracken and Ng document a splice of the historical SIC AMDMNO series with the NAICS DGORDER series. Historical-vintage documentation records a switch from the SIC+NAICS splice to SIC-only moving backward from 2001-04; units remain the same. Minor 2014-12 historical-vintage differences are attributed to compounded rounding in the constructed series. Retain the values exactly as supplied in each FRED-MD vintage and preserve genuine missingness.

FRED-MD adjusted series for manufacturers' unfilled orders of durable goods. McCracken and Ng document a splice of historical SIC and NAICS AMDMUO data. Historical-vintage documentation records a switch from the SIC+NAICS splice to SIC-only moving backward from 2001-04, with unchanged units. Minor 2014-12 differences reflect compounded rounding in construction. Retain the FRED-MD vintage values directly and preserve genuine missingness.

FRED-MD constructed/spliced real manufacturing and trade sales series. McCracken and Ng document adjustment of the historical M0602BUSM144NNBR series for inflation, seasonal adjustment, and splicing to the NAICS CMRMTSPL series. Historical-vintage documentation records changes in splice construction and chain-dollar units. The audit finds one exceptional 2015-08 vintage with an internal gap from 1967-01 through 1996-12; independent source re-extraction confirmed that the gap is present in the source vintage. Retain the series and preserve genuine vintage-specific NaNs; do not fill them using another vintage.

Official FRED-MD replacement. AMBSL is the St. Louis Adjusted Monetary Base and is seasonally adjusted. It was discontinued in December 2019. BOGMBASE is the Board of Governors Monetary Base: Total and is not seasonally adjusted. Treat as a documented but non-exact successor relationship; do not assume numerical equivalence across the 2020-01 transition.

Official FRED-MD successor to AMBSL beginning with the 2020-01 vintage. BOGMBASE is published by the Board of Governors and is not seasonally adjusted, unlike AMBSL. Use the common MONETARY_BASE canonical concept with an explicit methodological break at the transition.
